  3. 3" Round Universal VHX Clock

3" Round Universal VHX Clock




At long last, an analog clock with honest-to-goodness hands to match you VHX instrument system! With LED backlighting and specialized technology allowing two needles to be lit while riding on the same stepper motor, these direct-fit clock modules are the perfect complement to your VHX package. Only compatible with VHX systems; will not function as stand-alone units or with VFD3 digital systems.

Choose from 3 different background/ face and lighting options to match your VHX System:

  • Carbon Fiber background with your choice of Red or Blue LED backlight.
  • Black Alloy background with your choice of Red, White or Blue LED backlight.
  • Silver Alloy background with your choice of Red, White or Blue LED backlight.

Chromed billet aluminum housing provides a beautiful finished product.

Dimensions:
Cutout: 2-3/4"
Overall: 3"
